note: The Hebrew text says: “six boards at the rear of the Mishkan, to the Sea.” Jerome paraphrases: _contra occidentem vero, id est, ad eam partem tabernaculi quae mare respicit, fecit sex tabulas_ – but against the west, to wit, at the side of the tabernacle which looketh to the Sea, he made six boards (Douay Version). Why the paraphrase? Because Jerome wanted to keep the /Mediterranean) Sea, used in the biblical text rather often to indicate the west.
